name: tool-vision
description: Look at image files in the workspace: vision.look sends pixels to a vision model and returns text (describe / OCR / find)

settings.title: Vision
settings.description: vision.look: look at workspace images via model route vision then default. Needs openai-compat vision; Anthropic/Responses ignore images in side calls today.

fields.label: Model / route
fields.help: Empty = models.routes.vision, else models.default. Override with a models.routes key or provider/model-id (openai-compat vision).

fields.label: Max image size
fields.help: Same cap as chat blobs (8 MB).

fields.label: Reasoning
fields.help: Off by default. When on, a DeepSeek vision call may think before answering. The side call does not set max_tokens.

fields.label: Batch
fields.help: Max images in one model request. Default 4. Extra paths in the same vision.look call go out in further requests with the same prompt.
